# Library parts in the playground

Installed from their registries by install.mjs, imports made relative.

- https://uiarc.dev/r/arc-motion-tokens.json — Arc open core, free and open source (uiarc.dev/pricing)
- https://uiarc.dev/r/animated-counter.json — Arc open core, free and open source
- https://uiarc.dev/r/stepper.json — Arc open core, free and open source
- https://beui.dev/r/expanding-arrow-button.json — beUI free components, "the source is yours" (beui.dev)

Files:
- arc/motion-tokens.ts
- arc/lib/motion-tokens.ts
- arc/animated-counter/animated-counter.tsx
- arc/animated-counter/animated-counter.module.css
- arc/stepper/stepper.tsx
- arc/stepper/stepper.module.css
- beui/components/expanding-arrow-button.tsx
- beui/lib/ease.ts
- beui/lib/hooks/use-hover-capable.ts
